composition_subtypes.role: Greedy segmentation: scan and reset when duplicate reduced number found

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy segmentation with square-free reduction: split when a candidate duplicates in current segment, giving minimal parts.
payload.rationale: The solution uses one main greedy mechanism: it sequentially processes elements, removes square factors via precomputed primes, and splits into a new segment when a duplicate reduced value appears. No DP or amortized structures are used.
